#S1 Boxplot of growth rate for each isolate in M9 and R2A
```{r}

gr = read.csv("~/Desktop/PMXC_growthRate_M9_R2A.csv", header=T)

#Set strain order to match phylogeny 

ordered_asvs <- c("S9", "S33", "S8", "S120", "S14", 
                   "S29", "S30", "S21", "S11", "S11_c2", "S5", "S16", "S7", "S32", "S6", "S22", "S491", "S31", "S27", "S10", "S391", "S34", "S263", "S17", "S28", "S2", "S19") 

gr$Isolate <- factor(gr$Isolate, levels = ordered_asvs)

#Plot growth rate

ggplot(gr, aes(x = Isolate, y = r)) + 
  theme_bw() +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = Isolate)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  ylab("Growth Rate (r)") +
  xlab("Isolate")+
  scale_color_manual(values = col28) +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95"),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Media, ncol=1)

```







#S2 Temperature plots for each experiment
```{r}

# Read CSV file
data <- read.csv("~/Desktop/PMXC_Temps.csv", header = TRUE)

# Convert DateTime column to POSIXct
data$DateTime <- as.POSIXct(data$DateTime, format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S")

# Extract just the Date
data$Date <- as.Date(data$DateTime)

temp6 = data[data$Experiment=="PMXC6",]
temp7 = data[data$Experiment=="PMXC7",]

# Map each unique Date to a Day number (0 to 39)
unique_dates <- sort(unique(temp6$Date))
day_map <- setNames(0:(length(unique_dates)-1), unique_dates)
temp6$Day <- day_map[as.character(temp6$Date)]

unique_dates <- sort(unique(temp7$Date))
day_map <- setNames(0:(length(unique_dates)-1), unique_dates)
temp7$Day <- day_map[as.character(temp7$Date)]

temp6 <- subset(temp6, Light <= 0)
temp7 <- subset(temp7, Light <= 0)

T6 = ggplot(temp6, aes(x = DateTime, y = Temperature, color=Temp)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "R2A.CR",
       x = "Day",
       y = "Temperature (°C)") +
  theme_bw() +
   scale_x_datetime(
    breaks = seq(min(temp6$DateTime), max(temp6$DateTime), by = "48 hours"),
    labels = function(x) {
      day_labels <- temp6$Day[match(x, temp6$DateTime)]
      return(day_labels)
    }
  ) + ylim(15,30) +scale_color_manual(values = c("RT" = "blue", "VT" = "red"))

T7 = ggplot(temp7, aes(x = DateTime, y = Temperature, color = Temp)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "M9.CR",
       x = "Day",
       y = "Temperature (°C)") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_datetime(
    breaks = seq(min(temp7$DateTime), max(temp7$DateTime), by = "48 hours"),
    labels = function(x) {
      day_labels <- temp7$Day[match(x, temp7$DateTime)]
      return(day_labels)
    }
  ) +
  ylim(15, 30) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("RT" = "blue", "VT" = "red"))


library(ggpubr)

ggarrange(T7, T6, ncol=1)
```

#S3 Boxplot of ENS values at T12 by Experiment x Media
```{r}
pmxc = read.csv("~/Desktop/PMXC6_7_combined_ASVtable.csv", header=T)

pmxc = pmxc[pmxc$Time == "T12",]

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

facet_labels <- c("PMXC6" = "R2A.CR", 
                  "PMXC7" = "M9.CR")

names(pmxc) <- trimws(names(pmxc))



# Calculate stats for label placement above box + whiskers
summary_stats <- pmxc %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Media, Experiment) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_hill1 = mean(hill1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_hill1 = sd(hill1, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_hill1 = max(hill1, na.rm = TRUE),  # for label position
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("Mean±SD: ", round(mean_hill1, 1), "±", round(sd_hill1, 1)),
    label_y = max_hill1 + 0.3  # move label above the whisker
  )

pmxc$Experiment <- factor(pmxc$Experiment, levels = c("PMXC7", "PMXC6"))

# Plot
ggplot(pmxc, aes(x = Media, y = hill1)) + 
  theme_bw() +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = Media)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95"),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("ENS (q=1)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = color) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 12)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~Experiment, scales = "free", labeller = as_labeller(facet_labels))


```

#S5  Bray-Curtis changes over time
```{r}
#Load and organize data

#ASV table should have ASVs in columns and samples in rows
pmxc = read.csv("~/Desktop/PMXC6_7_combined_ASVtable_OGperSample.csv", header=T)

pmxc7 = pmxc[pmxc$Experiment == "PMXC7",]
pmxc6 = pmxc[pmxc$Experiment == "PMXC6",]

pmxc6 <- pmxc6[pmxc6$Day %in% c(0, 3, 24, 36, 39), ]

```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare ASV table and metadata
asv.table <- pmxc6[, 2:29]
asv.t <- asv.table[order(row.names(asv.table)), ]

md <- pmxc6[, 30:43]
md <- md[order(row.names(md)), ]
stopifnot(all(row.names(asv.t) == row.names(md)))

expfn <- asv.t
md.expf <- md

big <- data.frame()
microcosm <- unique(md.expf$Treatment)

for (i in microcosm) {
  # Subset by treatment
  md_sub <- md.expf[md.expf$Treatment == i, ]
  asv_sub <- expfn[md.expf$Treatment == i, ]
  
  # Order by Day
  ord <- order(md_sub$Day)
  md_sub <- md_sub[ord, ]
  asv_sub <- asv_sub[ord, ]
  
  # Drop empty ASVs
  asv_sub <- asv_sub[, colSums(asv_sub) > 0]
  
  # Compute Bray-Curtis distance matrix
  dist_mat <- as.matrix(vegdist(asv_sub, method = "bray"))
  
  # Compute average BC per Day (relative to all other samples in same treatment)
  day_vals <- unique(md_sub$Day)
  for (d in day_vals) {
    idx <- which(md_sub$Day == d)
    # mean of distances of samples at this day to all other samples in treatment
    avg_bc <- mean(dist_mat[idx, -idx], na.rm = TRUE)  # exclude self-comparisons
    big <- rbind(big, data.frame(
      Treatment = i,
      Day = d,
      AvgBC = avg_bc
    ))
  }
}

# Convert Treatment to factor if desired
big$Treatment = factor(big$Treatment, levels = c("SR2ARTNB", "SR2ARTB", "SR2AVTNB", "SR2AVTB","NSR2ARTNB", "NSR2ARTB", "NSR2AVTNB", "NSR2AVTB", "SCRRTNB", "SCRRTB", "SCRVTNB", "SCRVTB","NSCRRTNB", "NSCRRTB", "NSCRVTNB", "NSCRVTB"))

# Plot
BC6 = ggplot(big, aes(x = Day, y = AvgBC, color = Treatment)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Treatment), size = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Average Bray-Curtis dissimilarity", title = "R2A.CR") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )+ facet_wrap(~Treatment)+theme(legend.position = "none")+scale_color_manual(values = color)
```

for (i in microcosm) {
  # Subset by treatment

  asv_sub <- expfn[md.expf$Treatment == i, ]
  
  # Order by Day
  ord <- order(md_sub$Day)
  md_sub <- md_sub[ord, ]
  asv_sub <- asv_sub[ord, ]
  
  # Drop empty ASVs
  asv_sub <- asv_sub[, colSums(asv_sub) > 0]

  dist_mat <- as.matrix(vegdist(asv_sub, method = "bray"))
  
  # Compute average BC per Day (relative to all other samples in same treatment)

  for (d in day_vals) {
    idx <- which(md_sub$Day == d)
    # mean of distances of samples at this day to all other samples in treatment
    avg_bc <- mean(dist_mat[idx, -idx], na.rm = TRUE)  # exclude self-comparisons
    big <- rbind(big, data.frame(
      Treatment = i,
      Day = d,
      AvgBC = avg_bc
    ))
  }
}

# Convert Treatment to factor if desired
big$Treatment = factor(big$Treatment, levels = c("SM9RTNB", "SM9RTB", "SM9VTNB", "SM9VTB","NSM9RTNB", "NSM9RTB", "NSM9VTNB", "NSM9VTB",  "SCRRTNB", "SCRRTB", "SCRVTNB", "SCRVTB","NSCRRTNB", "NSCRRTB", "NSCRVTNB", "NSCRVTB"))

#S6 Original Composition plots
```{r}
pmxc = read.csv("~/Desktop/PMXC6_7_combined_ASVtable.csv", header=T)

#Subset to only OG
pmxc = pmxc[pmxc$Time == "OG",]

#Melt data into long format for barplot
long = reshape2::melt(pmxc, variable.name="Isolate", id.vars = c("Sample", "Time",  "Shake", "Media", "Temp", "Beads", "Rep", "Treatment", "ComplexityB", "Experiment", "ID", "Day", "hill0", "hill1", "hill2"))



# Define the desired order of ASVs
ordered_asvs <- c("S9", "S33", "S8", "S120", "S14", 
                   "S29", "S30", "S21", "S11", "S5", "S16", "S7", "S32", "S6", "S22", "S491", "S31", "S27", "S10", "S391", "S34", "S263", "S17", "S28", "S2", "S19", "Unassigned", "Rare") 



# Set the factor levels in desired order
long$Isolate <- factor(long$Isolate, levels = ordered_asvs)
long$Experiment <- factor(long$Experiment, levels = c("PMXC7", "PMXC6"))

facet_labels <- c("PMXC6" = "R2A.CR", 
                  "PMXC7" = "M9.CR")

ggplot(data = long, aes(fill=Isolate, y=value, x=Media)) +    
  theme_bw()+        
    geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity") +
   scale_fill_manual(values = col28) + theme(strip.text = element_text(
    size =10)) +theme(axis.text=element_text(size=15), legend.text = element_text(size=15),legend.key.size = unit(5, 'mm'), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),  axis.title.x=element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20, unit = "pt"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15))+ ylab("Relative Abundance") + guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol =1)) + facet_wrap(~Experiment, scales="free", labeller = as_labeller(facet_labels))


```
